purpose: Grow qualified ERN discovery traffic and downstream planning intent so traffic-gated Travelpayouts programs can become unlockable naturally.

workstreams.action: Maintain 275 strong searchable places with crawlable destination pages, aliases, country/region, source type, currentness, related ERN places and useful planning context. Replace or upgrade weak sources rather than growing count mechanically.
workstreams.successSignal: More non-owner organic search/AI discovery landing directly on destination pages.

workstreams.action: Use the 275-place catalog to deepen underrepresented search demand and upgrade distinctive destinations to stronger live/current sources rather than adding repetitive places.
workstreams.successSignal: Broader search-query coverage across place names, islands, mountains, parks and current-condition searches.

workstreams.action: Keep travel options downstream from a viewed/searched place and measure aggregate travel_option_opened by destination/intent.
workstreams.successSignal: Sustained qualified outbound planning clicks across multiple destinations.

workstreams.action: Use related destinations, Browse All, geography/category discovery and Wander to move visitors beyond the landing page.
workstreams.successSignal: More place opens per visitor and lower single-page abandonment.

workstreams.action: Use currently link-generation-capable utilities such as Airalo, Go City, Kiwitaxi, Radical Storage, Aviasales and KKday only where they solve a clear visitor need.
workstreams.successSignal: First genuine non-owner utility clicks/conversions without cluttering ERN.

workstreams.action: Recheck traffic-gated Travelpayouts programs only after a platform status change, first affiliate conversion, sustained qualified outbound activity, or material organic traffic growth.
workstreams.successSignal: A previously locked program exposes usable/approved link-generation controls.

note: 275-place soft stretch reached. Primary growth objective is now qualified organic discovery, deeper internal exploration and real planning clicks/conversions; Travelpayouts unlock thresholds are private and must not be invented.
